description: US companies (of the 390 Portfolio Terminal covers) reporting earnings in a month or a date range: the day, before the open or after the close, EPS and revenue estimates, whether the date is confirmed or estimated, and once out, the result against the consensus and how many recent quarters beat it. Filter by one ticker with `symbol`.

days.description: Length of the range that starts at `from`, in calendar days (1–31, default 10).

from.description: First day of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of `month`). Use it for "this week" or "the next 10 days".

limit.description: How many reports, earliest first, larger companies first on the same day to return (1–200, default 50).

month.description: A calendar month as YYYY-MM, from three months back to three months ahead. Defaults to the current month. Ignored when `from` is given.

name: earnings_calendar
title: Earnings calendar
